Refined charcoal #121212, quiet dark frosted glass mind map pills with mint #5EF0B0, sky #7CC4FF, lilac #C9A2FF connections; two floating dark presentation cards, diagram on one, three simple mint step blocks on other. Restrained edge illumination, editorial minimalism, precise rounded contours. This is BACKGROUND artwork for typography and real logos to be composited afterwards. Essential requirement: left 52% of canvas completely empty, uniformly dark for future logo and large typography. The mind map and overlapping slide sheets form one dimensional composition on the RIGHT, within x 57%-91%, y 22%-72%; the two slide sheets below and slightly in front of the map. Bottom 22% empty dark for App Store overlay. Finely dotted map canvas only around the map. Asymmetric luxury product launch composition; no objects on the left.
